method: Read-only source review; no App relaunch, user settings access, install, remote authority action, or tests added during final review. Python external-invalid child-export defect was reproduced only in SystemTemp before its fix; final correction was source-reviewed. Authors/root retain final C++/Python test execution responsibility.
closed_findings: CodeBuddy login invalid-path error arrays now have matching length and separate effective Node validation.
Native App executable layout, external manifest, polling and restart journal use the common verified HostRuntime shape; old raw layout remains compatible.
GongGong flush takes one effective snapshot for environment, provenance helper and workflow Python argv.
Local model discovery takes one snapshot for executable resolution and all discovery child environments.
Bridge with an explicit runtime scope no longer revives unavailable Node through bundled/PATH fallbacks.
Native and Python child environment exporters preserve raw true-external invalid overrides so descendants keep them unavailable instead of silently using configuration.
verified_invariants: Native helper initializes/locks/reads/writes without Python bootstrap.
Single-field locked atomic merges and fill-only legacy migration; no credential migration.
Self-contained paths precede ambient config locators; derived exports do not become startup external overrides.
Each reviewed runtime consumer uses current effective executables instead of stale runtime LineEdits.
Missing build Python is checked only for engine build, not chat/model operations.
GDScript local-model and issue-direct launch inputs share their operation snapshot.
Canonical registered CLI profiles are compared before execution; changed runtime bindings are rejected, registry/evaluation records are not silently rewritten; available_tools remains empty.
Engine source uses verified native origin or bare executable SConstruct ancestry; no old cli_bridge source fallback.
